commands.review_summary:
The PR bounds Copilot BYOK proxy request bodies at 16 MiB with a 30-second timeout and adds a shared body-reader option allowing callers to defer request destruction while returning HTTP errors.

PR surface: Source +40, Tests +68. Total +108 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main’s Copilot proxy reads a non-GET/HEAD body without a bound, and the supplied proof script provides a concrete oversized declared-length and chunked-request path; source inspection also exposes the final-head response-teardown race.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A maintainer must first choose whether caller-owned teardown belongs in the public plugin SDK; after that, the contributor can apply the narrow response-completion repair.
